label: Clone Voice
description: Create a voice on the account from sample recordings (instant voice clone). The minted voice id is a durable account asset: use it in any speak node from then on.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (the minted voice lives in it; the shared credential cannot serve this). ElevenLabs offers instant cloning on its Starter plan and above.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The new voice's name on the account.

inputs.name: samples
inputs.description: Recordings of the voice to clone. ElevenLabs says a few minutes of audio is enough for an instant clone.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: A note stored with the voice.

inputs.name: removeBackgroundNoise
inputs.label: Remove background noise
inputs.description: Turn on to clean the samples with ElevenLabs's audio isolation model before cloning. If the samples have no background noise, ElevenLabs warns it can make the quality worse.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Labels to store with the voice, each a name and a value. ElevenLabs names language, accent, gender and age as keys, like `{ "language": "en", "accent": "en-US" }`.

outputs.name: voiceId
outputs.description: The minted voice's id: what the speak nodes take.

outputs.name: requiresVerification
outputs.description: Whether ElevenLabs says the new voice requires verification.

then.message: ElevenLabsCloneVoice '{id}' has no recordings in `samples`, and ElevenLabs needs at least one to clone a voice: add one.
